items.name: Human–machine collaboration for improving semiconductor process development
items.description: Nature, 2023. [All Versions]. [Nature News]. This work studies Bayesian optimization algorithms to investigate how artificial intelligence (AI) might decrease the cost of developing complex semiconductor chip processes. In particular, this work create a controlled virtual process game to systematically benchmark the performance of humans and computers for the design of a semiconductor fabrication process. The authors find that human engineers excel in the early stages of development, whereas the algorithms are far more cost-efficient near the tight tolerances of the target.
